briefdescription.para: Phase 5 security module hot-path release-gate benchmarks (SRG-01..SRG-06).

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency measurements for the security hot paths identified in the security module roadmap (Phase 5). These are the hard release gates — a p99 regression beyond 10 % vs the baseline blocks promotion to production.

sect2.title: Gate table
sect2.para:
All benchmarks:
Use kSecurityCanonicalSeed = 42 for deterministic input data.
Run with Repetitions(5) to capture variance.
I/O-bound benchmarks use UseRealTime() so scheduler wait is included.
External dependencies (HSM, TLS stack, disk) are mocked in-process.
